name: Hearthforge Dragon - Adult
description: Adult Hearthforge is a good-leaning covenant intelligent true dragon with dark iron plates and hammered bronze horns. It seeks to defend artisans and sacred craft. At this age it is a commanding force in its territory.

attacks.name: Iron Jaws
attacks.description: The dragon strikes one target within Very Close range with its primary natural weapons.

abilities.name: Relentless (3)
abilities.description: The dragon can be spotlighted up to 3 times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

abilities.name: Iron Brace
abilities.description: While touching stone or metal, the dragon cannot be knocked back.

abilities.name: Forge Breath
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to exhale a cone reaching Close range. All enemies in the cone make an Agility Reaction Roll against Difficulty 18. On a failure, take 3d8+6 magic damage and one carried metal item of the target’s choice becomes too hot to handle until its next action, unless dropped. On a success, take half damage without the additional effect.

abilities.name: Siege Leap
abilities.description: Mark a Stress. Leap to a point within Close range and make an attack against every enemy within Very Close range of the landing point. Each success deals 3d8+6 physical damage and knocks the target back to Close range.

abilities.name: Tempered Plates
abilities.description: When the dragon takes physical damage, mark a Stress to reduce that instance of damage by 2d8.

abilities.name: Roused Fury
abilities.description: Once per scene, immediately after the dragon marks half its total HP (round up), clear 1 Stress and move up to Close range. This movement does not grant an attack.
